title: Scaling numerator and denominator of natDivSucc by the same successor leaves it unchanged
statement: For naturals j, k: natDivSucc(j+1, (j+1)*k + j) = natDivSucc(1, k), i.e. (j+1)/((j+1)*k+(j+1)) reduces to 1/(k+1).

formal.statement: theorem Rat.natDivSucc_scale : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} Rat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ x0) (AxNat.add (AxNat.mul (AxNat.succ x0) x1) x0)) (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) x1)))
